notes: Initial evals scaffolded 2026-05-15. Run via /skill-creator to populate grading.json and timing data.

evals.prompt: Controleer mijn House playlist — welke nummers passen er niet in?
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves 'House' from playlists.json. Runs list-tracks to get the track list. Offers web-first vs quick mode via AskUserQuestion. Produces an audit report with confidence scores. Asks threshold. Offers removal via AskUserQuestion.
expectations: Skill runs .venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py list-tracks 'House' via Bash
Skill offers audit mode choice (web-first vs quick) via AskUserQuestion
Skill produces an audit report showing score distribution (✅/⚠️/❌)
Skill asks for removal threshold via AskUserQuestion

evals.prompt: audit mijn House playlist, maar gebruik de snelle mode
evals.expected_output: Skill skips the mode-choice AskUserQuestion and goes directly to quick (OpenAI CLI) mode. Runs audit-playlist CLI. Shows output. Offers removal.
expectations: Skill uses quick mode (audit-playlist CLI) without asking for mode choice
Playlist name is double-quoted in the command
Skill offers removal of low-confidence tracks after showing the report

evals.prompt: welke nummers passen er niet in mijn Funny meme playlist?
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies 'Funny meme' as a theme playlist with special_rules. Applies the special_rule literally when scoring. Does NOT use genre match alone.
expectations: Skill reads special_rules for 'Funny meme' from playlists.json
Skill applies the meme/theme criteria when classifying tracks, not just genre
Audit report notes the theme-based scoring approach

evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to audit Random sht — it is the catch-all by design. Explains this in Dutch.
expectations: Skill does NOT run list-tracks or audit-playlist for 'Random sht'
Skill explains in Dutch that Random sht is the catch-all (every track belongs there)
Skill suggests auditing a specific genre playlist instead

evals.prompt: voeg dit nummer toe aan House: https://open.spotify.com/track/xxx
evals.expected_output: This is an ADD request, not an AUDIT request. Skill routes to /playlist-match.
expectations: Skill does NOT start an audit flow
Skill mentions /playlist-match as the right skill for adding tracks
Skill does not run any CLI commands
